name: git-status-line
description: Shows the current branch, ahead/behind and dirty file count in the status line.

debounceMs.title: Debounce (ms)
debounceMs.description: After a tool call, wait this long for more activity before running git status once.

showUntracked.title: Count untracked files
showUntracked.description: Include untracked files in the dirty count. Turn off in repositories where git status is slow.
